from pathlib import Path
import json

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
targets = [
    wt / "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    wt / "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    wt / "tests/test_browser.py",
    wt / "tests/test_daemon.py",
]
needles = [
    "notify_receipt",
    "notify_receipts",
    "browser_status",
    "pending_receipts",
    "response",
    "receipt",
    "ack",
    "history",
]
for path in targets:
    print(f"=== {path.relative_to(wt)} ===")
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if any(n in line for n in needles):
            hits.append(i)
    windows = []
    seen = set()
    for hit in hits[:80]:
        start = max(1, hit - 4)
        end = min(len(lines), hit + 8)
        key = (start, end)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        windows.append((start, end))
    for start, end in windows[:24]:
        print(f"--- lines {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start, end + 1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")
